methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Left hand, right hand: Virginia cools on data centers even as state policy promotes the AI that requires them
signals.signal_reading: Virginia's state AI policy requires data center infrastructure that communities are rejecting, creating a coordination failure where neither the enabling infrastructure nor the distributed capability materializes in underserved regions.

signals.title: Meta, Google invest in skilled worker training to build Virginia data centers - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Meta and Google investing in skilled worker training specifically to build their own data centers signals shallow, employment-focused training tied to concentrated infrastructure rather than distributed deep AI capability across communities.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional investment in leadership-level AI fluency outside major metros, potentially seeding peer networks that could distribute deep capability through the Roanoke Valley region.

signals.title: Virginia Tech Researchers Use AI to Gauge Manufacturing Water Needs - GovTech
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech researchers applying AI to manufacturing water needs demonstrates concentrated technical expertise solving specific industrial problems, but deployment remains research-driven rather than distributed through manufacturing communities statewide.

signals.title: Unprecedented growth shapes Pittsylvania County’s long-range planning efforts
signals.signal_reading: Pittsylvania County updating comprehensive plans to accommodate data centers, solar, and battery storage shows infrastructure-led adoption where AI arrives as platform services embedded in development projects rather than through local capability building.
